                                     Table "public.measurements_def"
 Column  |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default | Storage  | Compression | Stats target | Description 
---------+---------+-----------+----------+---------+----------+-------------+--------------+-------------
 id      | bigint  |           | not null |         | plain    |             |              | 
 logdate | date    |           | not null |         | plain    |             |              | 
 region  | text    |           | not null |         | extended |             |              | 
 val     | integer |           |          | 42      | plain    |             |              | 
Partition of: measurements DEFAULT
Partition constraint: (NOT ((logdate IS NOT NULL) AND (((logdate >= '2024-01-01'::date) AND (logdate < '2025-01-01'::date)) OR ((logdate >= '2025-01-01'::date) AND (logdate < '2026-01-01'::date)))))
Indexes:
    "measurements_def_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (id, logdate)
    "measurements_def_region_idx" btree (region)
Access method: heap
